pdfinfo.Title: Including Space-Time in the Extended Group   of Relativistic Form-Invariance
pdfinfo.Subject: The inclusion of space-time in the extended group of relativistic form-inva- riance,  , is specified as the inclusion of the whole space-time manifold in this multiplicative Lie group. First physical results presented here are: the geometric origin of the time arrow, a better understanding of the non-simultaneity in optics and a mainly geometric origin for the universe expansion, and its recent acceleration.
pdfinfo.Keywords: Space-Time Manifold, Invariance Group, Standard Model, Acceleration of Expansion
pdfinfo.Author: Claude Daviau1, Jacques Bertrand
